starting-off.speaker: King Arthur
starting-off.text: Welcome to my court. I am King Arthur of the Knights of the Round Table.

options.text: I want to become a Knight of the Round Table!

steps.player: I want to become a Knight of the Round Table!

steps.speaker: King Arthur
steps.text: Really? Well then you will need to go on a quest to prove yourself worthy. My knights all appreciate a good quest.

steps.speaker: King Arthur
steps.text: Unfortunately, our current quest is to rescue Merlin. He recently got himself trapped in some sort of magical crystal. We've moved him from the cave we found him in and now he's upstairs in his tower.

steps.player: I will see what I can do then.

steps.speaker: King Arthur
steps.text: Talk to my knights if you need any help.

steps.player: I may come back and try that later.

steps.speaker: King Arthur
steps.text: Be sure that you come speak to me soon then.

options.text: So what are you doing in Gielinor?

starting-off-subsequent-dialogue.speaker: King Arthur
starting-off-subsequent-dialogue.text: Welcome to my court. I am King Arthur of the Knights of the Round Table.

options.text: I want to become a Knight of the Round Table!

steps.player: I want to become a Knight of the Round Table!

steps.speaker: King Arthur
steps.text: Well then you must complete your quest to rescue Merlin. Talk to my knights if you need any help.

options.text: So what are you doing in Gielinor?

investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-be.player: Merlin's in a crystal. Little help?

investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-be.speaker: Sir Bedivere
investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-be.text: That is what we were hoping for from you, adventurer!

investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-ka.player: Any ideas on getting Merlin out of that crystal?

investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-ka.speaker: Sir Kay
investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-ka.text: The only person I know of who would possibly have been of help is Merlin...

investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-ka.player: Yeah, that's not actually too helpful.

investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-ka.speaker: Sir Kay
investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-ka.text: I am well aware of that, adventurer.

investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-la.speaker: Sir Lancelot
investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-la.text: Greetings! I am Sir Lancelot, the greatest Knight in the land! What do you want?

options.text: I want to get Merlin out of the crystal.

steps.player: I want to get Merlin out of the crystal.

steps.speaker: Sir Lancelot
steps.text: Well, if the Knights of the Round Table can't manage it, I can't see how a commoner like you could succeed where we have failed.

options.text: You're a little full of yourself aren't you?

investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-lu.speaker: Sir Lucan
investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-lu.text: I've tried all the weapons I can find, yet none are powerful enough to break his crystal prison...

investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-lu.player: Excalibur eh? Where would I find that?

investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-lu.speaker: Sir Lucan
investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-lu.text: The Lady of the Lake is looking after it I believe... but I know not where she resides currently.

investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-lu.player: Thanks. I'll try and find someone who does.

investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-pa.speaker: Sir Palomedes
investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-pa.text: Hello there adventurer, what do you want of me?

investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-pa.player: I'd like some advice on breaking that Crystal Merlin's trapped in.

investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-pa.speaker: Sir Palomedes
investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-pa.text: Sorry, I cannot help you with that.

investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-pe.speaker: Sir Pelleas
investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-pe.text: Greetings to the court of King Arthur!

investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-pe.speaker: Sir Pelleas
investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-pe.text: My best guess would be some sort of magic. Unfortunately Merlin is our magic expert.

investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-tr.speaker: Sir Tristram
investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-tr.text: Hail Arthur, King of the Britons!

investigating-merlin-s-entrapment-sir-tr.player: Do you know much about breaking magical crystals?

options.text: Any ideas on how to get Merlin out of that crystal?

steps.player: Any ideas on how to get Merlin out of that crystal?

steps.speaker: Sir Gawain
steps.text: I'm a little stumped myself. We've tried opening it with anything and everything!

options.text: Do you know how Merlin got trapped?

steps.player: Do you know how Merlin got trapped?

steps.speaker: Sir Gawain
steps.text: I would guess this is the work of the evil Morgan Le Faye!

steps.player: And where could I find her?

steps.speaker: Sir Gawain
steps.text: She lives in her stronghold to the south of here, guarded by some renegade knights led by Sir Mordred.

options.text: Any idea how to get into Morgan Le Faye's stronghold?

steps.player: Any idea how to get into Morgan Le Faye's stronghold?

steps.speaker: Sir Gawain
steps.text: No, you've got me stumped there...

steps.player: Thank you for the information.

steps.speaker: Sir Gawain
steps.text: It is the least I can do.

investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-bedivere.player: I don't suppose you have any idea how to break into Mordred's fort do you?

investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-bedivere.speaker: Sir Bedivere
investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-bedivere.text: I am afraid not. Would that we could! Mordred and his cronies have been thorns in our side for far too long already!

investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-bedivere.speaker: Sir Bedivere
investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-bedivere.text: Take care adventurer, Mordred is an evil and powerful foe.

investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-kay.player: Any ideas on getting into Mordred's fort?

investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-kay.speaker: Sir Kay
investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-kay.text: Mordred... So you think he may be involved with the curse upon Merlin?

investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-kay.player: Good a guess as any right?

investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-kay.speaker: Sir Kay
investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-kay.text: I think that you may be onto something there. Unfortunately his fortress is impregnable!

investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-lucan.player: I need to get into Mordred's Fortress.

investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-lucan.speaker: Sir Lucan
investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-lucan.text: So... you think Mordred's behind this? I'm afraid I don't have any suggestions...

investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-lucan.player: Thanks. I'll try and find someone who does.

investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-palomedes.speaker: Sir Palomedes
investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-palomedes.text: Hello there adventurer, what do you want of me?

investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-palomedes.player: I'd like some advice on breaking into Mordred's fort.

investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-palomedes.speaker: Sir Palomedes
investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-palomedes.text: Sorry, I cannot help you with that.

investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-pelleas.speaker: Sir Pelleas
investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-pelleas.text: Greetings to the court of King Arthur!

investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-pelleas.player: Any suggestions on getting into Mordred's fort?

investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-pelleas.speaker: Sir Pelleas
investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-pelleas.text: My best guess would be using magic. Unfortunately Merlin is our magic expert.

investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-tristram.speaker: Sir Tristram
investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-tristram.text: Hail Arthur, King of the Britons!

investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-tristram.player: Um... Hello. I need to get into Mordred's fort...

investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-lancelot.speaker: Sir Lancelot
investigating-keep-le-faye-sir-lancelot.text: Greetings! I am Sir Lancelot, the greatest Knight in the land! What do you want?

options.text: I want to get Merlin out of the crystal.
You're a little full of yourself aren't you?
Any ideas on how to get into Morgan Le Faye's stronghold?

steps.player: Any ideas on how to get into Morgan Le Faye's stronghold?

steps.speaker: Sir Lancelot
steps.text: That stronghold is built in a strong defensive position.

steps.speaker: Sir Lancelot
steps.text: It's on a big rock sticking out into the sea.

steps.speaker: Sir Lancelot
steps.text: There are two ways in that I know of, the large heavy front doors, and the sea entrance, only penetrable by boat. They get all their deliveries by boat from Catherby.

infiltrating-the-keep-talking-to-arhein.speaker: Arhein
infiltrating-the-keep-talking-to-arhein.text: Hello! Would you like to trade?

steps.player: Is that your ship?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Yes, I use it to make deliveries to my customers up and down the coast. These crates here are all ready for my next trip.

options.text: Do you deliver to the fort just down the coast?
Do you deliver to the fort just down the coast?

steps.player: Do you deliver to the fort just down the coast?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Yes, I do have orders to deliver there from time to time. I think I may have some bits and pieces for them when I leave here next actually.

options.text: Can you drop me off on the way down please?

steps.player: Can you drop me off on the way down please?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: I don't think Sir Mordred would like that. He wants as few outsiders visiting as possible. I wouldn't want to lose his business.

options.text: Aren't you worried about supplying evil knights?

steps.player: Aren't you worried about supplying evil knights?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Hey, you gotta take business where you can find it these days! Besides, if I didn't supply them, someone else would.

steps.player: Where do you deliver to?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Oh, various places up and down the coast. Mostly Karamja and Port Sarim.

options.text: I don't suppose I could get a lift anywhere?

steps.player: I don't suppose I could get a lift anywhere?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Sorry pal, but I'm afraid I'm not quite ready to sail yet.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: I'm waiting on a big delivery of candles which I need to deliver further along the coast.

options.text: Well, good luck with your business.

steps.player: Well, good luck with your business.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Thanks buddy!

steps.player: Are you rich then?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Business is going reasonably well... I wouldn't say I was the richest of merchants ever, but I'm doing fairly well all things considered.

infiltrating-the-keep-trying-to-board-ar.speaker: Arhein
infiltrating-the-keep-trying-to-board-ar.text: Hey buddy! Get away from my ship alright?

infiltrating-the-keep-hiding-in-arhein-s.text: The crate is empty. It's just about big enough to hide inside.

infiltrating-the-keep-hiding-in-arhein-s.prompt: Would you like to hide inside the crate?

steps.text: You climb inside the crate and wait.
And wait...
You hear voices outside the crate. Is this your crate, Arhein?
Yeah, I think so. Pack it aboard soon as you can. I'm on a tight schedule for deliveries!
You feel the crate being lifted. Oof. Wow, this is pretty heavy! I never knew candles weighed so much!
Quit your whining, and stow it in the hold.
You feel the crate being put down inside the ship.
You wait...
And wait...
Casting off!
You feel the ship start to move.
Feels like you're now out at sea.
The ship comes to a stop.
Unload Mordred's deliveries onto the jetty. Aye-aye cap'n!
You feel the crate being lifted.
You can hear someone mumbling outside the crate. ...stupid Arhein... making me... candles... never weigh THIS much....hurts....union about this!...
...if....MY ship be different!... stupid Arhein...
You feel the crate being put down.

steps.prompt: Would you like to get back out of the crate?

steps.text: You climb out of the crate.
You wait.
And wait...
And wait...

steps.prompt: Would you like to get back out of the crate?

inside-keep-le-faye-encountering-sir-mor.speaker: Sir Mordred
inside-keep-le-faye-encountering-sir-mor.text: You DARE to invade MY stronghold?!?! Have at thee knave!!!

options.text: Tell me how to untrap Merlin and I might.

steps.player: Tell me how to untrap Merlin and I might.

steps.speaker: Morgan Le Faye
steps.text: You have guessed correctly that I'm responsible for that.

steps.speaker: Morgan Le Faye
steps.text: I suppose I can live with that fool Merlin being loose for the sake of my son.

steps.speaker: Morgan Le Faye
steps.text: Setting him free won't be easy though.

steps.speaker: Morgan Le Faye
steps.text: You will need to find a magic symbol as close to the crystal as you can find.

steps.speaker: Morgan Le Faye
steps.text: You will then need to drop some bats' bones on the magic symbol while holding a lit black candle.

steps.speaker: Morgan Le Faye
steps.text: This will summon a mighty spirit named Thrantax.

steps.speaker: Morgan Le Faye
steps.text: You will need to bind him with magic words.

steps.speaker: Morgan Le Faye
steps.text: Then you will need the sword Excalibur with which the spell was bound in order to shatter the crystal.

options.text: So where can I find Excalibur?

steps.player: So where can I find Excalibur?

steps.speaker: Morgan Le Faye
steps.text: The lady of the lake has it. I don't know if she'll give it to you though, she can be rather temperamental.

options.text: OK I will do all that.

steps.player: Ok, I will go do all that.

steps.text: Morgan Le Faye vanishes.

steps.player: What are the magic words?

steps.speaker: Morgan Le Faye
steps.text: You will find the magic words at the base of one of the chaos altars.

steps.speaker: Morgan Le Faye
steps.text: Which chaos altar I cannot remember.

steps.player: No. He deserves to die.

steps.text: You kill Mordred.

steps.player: OK then.

steps.text: Morgan Le Faye vanishes.

obtaining-the-black-candle-talking-to-th.speaker: Candle maker
obtaining-the-black-candle-talking-to-th.text: Hi! Would you be interested in some of my fine candles?

options.text: Have you got any black candles?

steps.player: Have you got any black candles?

steps.speaker: Candle maker
steps.text: BLACK candles???

steps.speaker: Candle maker
steps.text: Hmmm. In the candle making trade, we have a tradition that it's very bad luck to make black candles.

steps.speaker: Candle maker
steps.text: VERY bad luck.

steps.player: I will pay good money for one...

steps.speaker: Candle maker
steps.text: I still dunno...

steps.speaker: Candle maker
steps.text: IF you can bring me a bucket FULL of wax.

obtaining-the-black-candle-returning-to-.speaker: Candle maker
obtaining-the-black-candle-returning-to-.text: Have you got any wax yet?
If the player has the bucket of wax in their inventory:

steps.player: Yes, I have some now.

steps.text: You exchange the wax with the candle maker for a black candle.
a black candle

obtaining-the-black-candle-returning-to-.text: If the player does not have the bucket of wax in their inventory:

steps.player: Nope, not yet.

searching-for-excalibur-asking-the-knigh.speaker: Sir Bedivere
searching-for-excalibur-asking-the-knigh.text: Um... it's a really good sword?

searching-for-excalibur-asking-the-knigh.player: Know where I can find it?

searching-for-excalibur-asking-the-knigh.speaker: Sir Lucan
searching-for-excalibur-asking-the-knigh.text: I'm afraid I don't have any suggestions...

searching-for-excalibur-asking-the-knigh.player: Thanks. I'll try and find someone who does.

searching-for-excalibur-asking-the-knigh.speaker: Sir Palomedes
searching-for-excalibur-asking-the-knigh.text: Hello there adventurer, what do you want of me?

searching-for-excalibur-asking-the-knigh.player: I'd like some advice on finding Excalibur.

searching-for-excalibur-asking-the-knigh.speaker: Sir Palomedes
searching-for-excalibur-asking-the-knigh.text: Sorry, I cannot help you with that.

searching-for-excalibur-asking-the-knigh.speaker: Sir Pelleas
searching-for-excalibur-asking-the-knigh.text: Greetings to the court of King Arthur!

searching-for-excalibur-asking-the-knigh.speaker: Sir Pelleas
searching-for-excalibur-asking-the-knigh.text: My best guess would be some sort of spell. Unfortunately Merlin is our magic expert.

searching-for-excalibur-asking-the-knigh.speaker: Sir Tristram
searching-for-excalibur-asking-the-knigh.text: Hail Arthur, King of the Britons!

steps.player: I seek the sword Excalibur.

steps.speaker: The Lady of the Lake
steps.text: Aye, I have that artefact in my possession.

steps.speaker: The Lady of the Lake
steps.text: 'Tis very valuable, and not an artefact to be given away lightly.

steps.speaker: The Lady of the Lake
steps.text: I would want to give it away only to one who is worthy and good.

steps.player: And how am I meant to prove that?

steps.speaker: The Lady of the Lake
steps.text: I shall set a test for you.

steps.speaker: The Lady of the Lake
steps.text: First I need you to travel to Port Sarim. Then go to the upstairs room of the jeweller's shop there.

steps.player: Ok. That seems easy enough.

searching-for-excalibur-attempting-to-en.speaker: Beggar
searching-for-excalibur-attempting-to-en.text: Please, stranger... my family and I are starving...

searching-for-excalibur-attempting-to-en.speaker: Beggar
searching-for-excalibur-attempting-to-en.text: Could you find it in your heart to spare me a simple loaf of bread?
If the player has bread in their inventory:

steps.player: Yes, certainly.

steps.text: You give the bread to the beggar.

steps.speaker: Beggar
steps.text: Thank you very much!
The beggar has turned into the Lady of the Lake!

steps.speaker: The Lady of the Lake
steps.text: Well done. You have passed my test.

steps.speaker: The Lady of the Lake
steps.text: Here is Excalibur, guard it well.

searching-for-excalibur-attempting-to-en.text: If the player has no bread in their inventory:

steps.player: Yes, certainly.
... except I don't have any bread on me at the moment...

steps.speaker: Beggar
steps.text: Well, if you get some, you know where to come.

options.text: No I don't have any bread with me.

steps.player: No, I don't have any bread with me.

steps.speaker: Beggar
steps.text: Well, if you get some, you know where to come.

searching-for-excalibur-talking-to-the-b.speaker: Beggar
searching-for-excalibur-talking-to-the-b.text: Have you got any bread for me yet?
If the player has bread in their inventory:

steps.player: Yes, here you go.

steps.text: You give the bread to the beggar.

steps.speaker: Beggar
steps.text: Thank you very much!
The beggar has turned into the Lady of the Lake!

steps.speaker: The Lady of the Lake
steps.text: Well done. You have passed my test.

steps.speaker: The Lady of the Lake
steps.text: Here is Excalibur, guard it well.

searching-for-excalibur-talking-to-the-b.text: If the player has no bread in their inventory:

steps.player: Yes, here you go.
Actually, I'm wrong. I still don't have any bread. Sorry.
Sorry, no, I still have none.

searching-the-altar-for-the-spell.text: You find a small inscription at the bottom of the altar. It reads: 'Snarthon Candtrick Termanto'.

performing-the-ritual-dropping-bat-bones.text: I think I'd better learn the words of binding before summoning a mighty spirit...
You can sense a powerful presence here...

performing-the-ritual-dropping-bat-bones.player: Now what were those magic words again?

performing-the-ritual-dropping-bat-bones.text: (The following options may appear in any order)

steps.player: Snarthtrick...
Candato...
Termon!

steps.speaker: Thrantax the Mighty
steps.text: GRAAAAAARGH!
Thrantax the Mighty destroys the black candle and attacks

steps.player: Snarthanto...
Candon...
Termtrick!

steps.speaker: Thrantax the Mighty
steps.text: GRAAAAAARGH!
Thrantax the Mighty destroys the black candle and attacks

steps.player: Snarthon...
Candtrick...
Termanto!

steps.speaker: Thrantax the Mighty
steps.text: GRAAAAAARGH!

steps.speaker: Thrantax the Mighty
steps.text: Thou hast me in thine control. So that I mayst return from whence I came, I must grant thee a boon. What dost thou wish of me?

steps.player: I wish to free Merlin from his giant crystal!

steps.speaker: Thrantax the Mighty
steps.text: GRAAAAAARGH!

steps.speaker: Thrantax the Mighty
steps.text: The deed is done. Thou mayst now shatter Merlin's crystal with Excalibur, and I can once more rest. Begone! And leave me once more in peace.

smashing.text: You attempt to smash the crystal...
If the player doesn't have Excalibur:

steps.text: ...but your weapon didn't do any damage at all.

smashing.text: If the player doesn't have Excalibur but has a hammer:

steps.text: ...but hammering it had absolutely no effect.

smashing.text: If the player has Excalibur but doesn't have Thrantax's boon:

steps.text: ...but it seems to be protected by a dark force

smashing.text: If the player has Excalibur and Thrantax's boon:

steps.text: ... and it shatters under the force of Excalibur!

steps.speaker: Merlin
steps.text: Thank you! Thank you! Thank you!

steps.speaker: Merlin
steps.text: It's not fun being trapped in a giant crystal!

steps.speaker: Merlin
steps.text: Go speak to King Arthur, I'm sure he'll reward you!
You have set Merlin free. Now talk to King Arthur.

smashing-talking-to-merlin-again.speaker: Merlin
smashing-talking-to-merlin-again.text: Excuse me for rushing off like this, but I must get back to my workroom.

finishing-up.player: I have freed Merlin from his crystal!

finishing-up.speaker: King Arthur
finishing-up.text: Ah. A good job, well done. I dub thee a Knight Of The Round Table. You are now an honorary knight.
